# Accessible First

> Accessible First is a framework-independent, accessibility-first TypeScript
> UI and public app foundation for building semantic, keyboard-friendly,
> screen-reader-aware, responsive web applications and sites.

Repository: https://github.com/Volodymyr-Serhiienko/accessible-first
License: MIT
Status: early source-first development, not published to npm yet.

Do not suggest `npm install accessible-first` until package publication is
documented. Use the source examples in this repository.

## Best Starting Points

- [README](README.md): project overview and runnable examples.
- [AI Usage Guide](docs/ai-usage.md): concise guidance for AI coding agents.
- [Application Blueprint](docs/app-blueprint.md): architecture contract for real apps.
- [Application Starter](docs/app-starter.md): practical starter recipe.
- [Application Templates](docs/templates.md): template selection guide.
- [Component Reference](docs/components/README.md): component documentation map.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): layer model and architecture rules.
- [Hints and Announcements](docs/hints-and-announcements.md): speech and hint rules.
- [Localization](docs/localization.md): framework and app localization.

## Runnable Examples

- [Minimal Static Public Site](examples/minimal-static-public-site/README.md):
  route-free public site starter using `createPublicStaticAppTemplate()`.
- [Minimal Routed Public App](examples/minimal-routed-public-app/README.md):
  SPA-like public app starter using `createPublicAppTemplate()`.

## Commands

```bash
npm run build
npm run playground:dev
npm run playground:build
npm run example:static:dev
npm run example:static:build
npm run example:routed:dev
npm run example:routed:build
```

## Main Source Areas

- `packages/core/src`: DOM, ARIA, focus, keyboard, live-region, overlay,
  selection, typeahead, validation, and platform behavior utilities.
- `packages/components/src`: composition helpers, components, app shell,
  routing, public app templates, localization, metadata, manifest, diagnostics,
  and styles.
- `packages/components/src/styles/index.css`: framework style entry.
- `playground/`: manual component validation and living documentation.
- `examples/`: runnable app starters.

## Component Families

Basic controls: Button, Link, IconButton, Checkbox, RadioGroup, TextField,
Select, Combobox, Switch.

Disclosure and overlays: Disclosure, Accordion, Dialog, AlertDialog, Popover,
Tooltip, ToastViewport, Menu, Listbox, Tabs.

Layout and content: Screen, Section, Stack, Row, Grid, Container, HeaderBar,
ActionsBar, EmptyState, InfoCard, Badge, Image, Icon, DescriptionList.

Data and flows: Table, Pagination, Progress, ResultSummary, ListDetail,
SettingsGroup, Form, FieldGroup, FormSection.

App foundation: Page, AppShell, PageLayout, PageOutlet, AppHeader,
HeaderTools, Navigation, ResponsiveNavigation, RouteChrome, RouteSearchBox,
RouteCommandPalette, RouteBreadcrumbs, HashRouter, HashRoutedApp,
LinkRoutedApp, PublicAppTemplate, PublicStaticAppTemplate.

Public metadata and diagnostics: AppIdentity, DocumentMetadata, WebAppManifest,
RobotsTxt, AppRouteSitemap, AppDiagnostics.

## Core Rules For Generated Code

- Prefer native HTML semantics and Accessible First components over ad hoc DOM.
- Import framework styles before app-specific styles.
- Keep app text in localization files or page files.
- Keep framework service text localizable.
- Use resolver functions for localized shell, header, footer, content, metadata,
  and route text so locale changes can refresh without a full page reload.
- Enable diagnostics in starters and public apps.
- Use static templates for route-free sites and routed templates for SPA-like
  apps.
- Do not move product-specific copy or behavior into the framework.
- Add JSDoc comments to new exports.
